expectations.text: Describes Assigned Representative registration: EU Login account with MFA, portal selection of the CSIRT Designated as Coordinator (main establishment; non-EU fallback cascade), legal agreement, Primary AR plus up to ~20 Secondary ARs
expectations.evidence: No Assigned Representative concept, no confirmed EU Login/MFA (only speculation: 'whether it requires an EU Login/eIDAS-based identity... may still be rolling out unevenly'), no legal agreement, no Primary/Secondary AR structure

expectations.text: Notes CSIRT validation runs in parallel and a limited number of notifications (~20) can be filed before verification completes
expectations.evidence: No mention of parallel CSIRT validation or the ~20 pre-verification notifications allowance

expectations.text: Relays ENISA's advice to register when a notification is needed rather than pre-emptively
expectations.evidence: Contradicts ENISA's advice — recommends pre-emptive onboarding: 'Registering your team's contact details and authentication credentials with the CSIRT/platform ahead of an actual incident avoids losing time'

expectations.text: Fallback: if the SRP is temporarily unavailable, contact the designated CSIRT directly for urgent communication — but the notification must still be submitted via the SRP once restored
expectations.evidence: 'Contact your national CSIRT directly through its published out-of-platform channel'; 'Submit the full notification through the platform as soon as it's restored'

expectations.text: Mentions at least one launch practicality accurately: English-only interface, no API at launch, or the Particular Exceptional Circumstances mechanism (Art. 16(2)) limiting simultaneous ENISA availability
expectations.evidence: No English-only, no-API, or Art. 16(2) Particular Exceptional Circumstances mention; instead hedges that platform availability 'may still be rolling out unevenly', contradicting the launch
